This plot is my small perennial garden near the house — I keep enset and a few fruit trees there, as we have done for generations. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer for this plot, and perennials do not need it like teff does; instead I carry manure and household compost from our cattle and kitchen to feed the plants. The seedlings I use come from my own suckers and from neighbors, not from the cooperative. I will tend it myself with help from the children — weeding, mulching, and harvesting — and I will not hire anyone for such a small garden.
